title: ConnectionConfiguration
description: A data collection configuration that limits monitoring to specific cloud services, regions, and resource groups for a connection.

id.description: The unique identifier of the configuration.

connectionId.description: The ID of the cloud connection this configuration belongs to.

services.description: The list of cloud services to monitor.

regions.description: The list of cloud regions to monitor.

resourceGroups.description: The list of resource groups to monitor (Azure-specific).

polling.description: Polling configuration for data collection frequency.

unit.description: The time unit for the polling interval.
